description: IFRC Network Databank country one-pager — aligned with the IFRC Brand System (https://brand.ifrc.org/ifrc-brand-system): primary red, navy, black and white palette; Montserrat headings; Open Sans body; horizontal IFRC logo. Layout mirrors Unified Plan/Report country snapshot structure (key figures, trend, cited narrative).

layout.logo: IFRC horizontal logo (inline SVG in html_template — do not substitute a generic red-cross icon)

pdf_page.note: If generating a PDF directly (e.g. Python reportlab/fpdf2) rather than converting the filled HTML, use your library's standard A4 page size (e.g. reportlab.lib.pagesizes.A4) with ~36pt (0.5in) margins. page_max_width_px above is the HTML/CSS reference, not a PDF unit.

rendering_rules: Always start from html_template — never invent a new layout when this style is requested.
Keep Montserrat for headings/titles and Open Sans for body, KPI labels, citations, and footer.
Use primary red sparingly (accent bar, KPI card tops, section markers) — not as a full-page gradient.
Place the IFRC horizontal logo in the header; wordmark must read IFRC exactly as in the template.
Section order: header → key figures → trend → narrative themes → footer/source note.
Cite narrative themes with document_title + page_number; hyperlink country names when document_url is present.
